items.headline: UK forecast remains in a colder phase
items.snippet: The first widespread frost of autumn for many is a strong reminder that the forecast has entered a colder phase for at least a few days.

items.headline: Fog giving way to colder weather and frost later this week
items.snippet: Fog and rain will affect parts of the UK this week, with a yellow fog warning in place overnight for parts of central England and Wales, before colder and increasingly frosty conditions spread south.
